carpetoocaddition.carpet_translations.ca: Fletchers sell tipped arrows of Weakness instead of a randomly chosen potion
Librarians sell enchanted books at the enchantment's own maximum level

Drops for blocks destroyed by a headless piston: false = vanilla (no drops), droppable = only blocks whose loot table yields something, all = also blocks without a loot table (bedrock, end portal frame, ...); dropped spawners keep their block entity data (NBT)
Villages no longer spawn cats (witch hut cats are unaffected)

Hitting a villager grants the player the same gossip as curing a zombie villager (one hit = one cure). The MAJOR_POSITIVE cap is lifted while this rule is on, so the discount is permanent and stacks; violence never creates negative reputation
Hitting a villager with an empty hand gives it Regeneration V for 3 seconds, so it survives while you farm the discount
Master toolsmiths sell only a diamond pickaxe with Unbreaking III, Efficiency III and Silk Touch
Armorers sell only their best enchanted diamond armor
Huge mushrooms can replace end portal frames while growing
The highest beacon tier applies Saturation instead of Regeneration
Diamond gear upgrades to netherite with just a netherite ingot: the netherite upgrade smithing template is not needed and is not consumed. Server-side only, vanilla clients work as is
Right-clicking an unpowered piston (sticky piston included) with an axe turns it into a headless piston without emitting any block update
Items carrying block entity data (spawner, command block, lectern, signs, trial spawner, ...) restore that data on placement for every player, instead of only for game-master/op players
